newsitem.title: ITALY: Berlusconi says does not want to unhinge coalition.
newsitem.headline: Berlusconi says does not want to unhinge coalition.

text.p: Former prime minister Silvio Berlusconi said on Tuesday he did not want to "unhinge" Italy's governing coalition and was willing to collaborate on proposals to bring forward the 1998 budget.

"We don't want to enter furtively into this coalition in order to unhinge it," the leader of the Freedom Alliance told a radio interviewer who had asked if the opposition had a hidden motive in offering its collaboration with the government.
Berlusconi has said several times recently that he was open to government proposals to bring forward the 1998 budget as long as it contained structural measures to cut social welfare spending.
